grep -o 'exports.version = "[^"]*"' dist/compiled/react-experimental/cjs/react.development.js dist/compiled/react/cjs/react.development.js; grep -rl 'viewTransition' dist --include=*.js | head -20

grep -rn 'viewTransition' dist/server/config-schema.js dist/server/config-shared.js dist/build/webpack-config.js dist/build/create-compiler-aliases.js 2>/dev/null | head -20; echo ---; grep -rn 'viewTransition\|ViewTransition' dist/client/components/*.js dist/client/components/**/*.js 2>/dev/null | grep -v '\.map' | head -30

pwd; ls; ls dist | head -30

ls dist/docs; grep -rli 'view transition\|viewTransition' dist/docs | head

cd /workspace; git checkout tsconfig.json; rm -rf tsconfig.tsbuildinfo; npx playwright --version 2>&1 | tail -1; ls node_modules/.bin | grep -i playwright
